checkpoint_finding.declared_training_corpus: Only retained, registered training evidence sources outside the held native-build LD/locus/gene blocks
checkpoint_finding.embedded_upstream_training_corpus: none; selected release is source code without learned biological weights
checkpoint_finding.source_chronology_interpretation: The selected code release predates GSE281160 and GSE281364 and carries no checkpoint. Exposure is controlled by project graph manifests, not source-code date alone.

interpretation: BIONIC is an open, locally trained, unsupervised network-integration comparator, not a pretrained checkpoint. It can test whether separate retained evidence networks contain recoverable structure, but the native model is homogeneous, undirected, closed-world, and transductive. Under the campaign's full held-block incident-edge removal, block-only nodes are untestable. No wholly held-back graph source is registered, so BIONIC cannot earn a best-model claim in the current campaign.
known_incidents_and_biases: The model's first linear projection and per-source encoders are indexed by the union training-node count. A whole-graph fit performed before a source or block split would directly contaminate every downstream fold.
BIONIC v0.2.6 converts each network to undirected form and shares a union node index. Edge direction and within-source relation type are not represented.

The preprocessor adds self-loops for the union nodes to every network while a separate mask denotes whether a node was originally present. A node absent from all retained evidence has no valid integrated support and cannot be rescued by the added loop or embedding bias.

Unsupervised reconstruction treats zero adjacency entries among network-supported nodes as negative signal. Consulting the held source to repair hidden positives would leak outcomes, so this closed-world mismatch must remain and be disclosed.
Supplying label_names activates a supervised classification path. All project fits must keep label_names=null so current Gene Catalog, COLOC, MPRA, and CROP-seq outcomes cannot enter the encoder.
The native pretrained_model_path calls torch.load without a restricted weights-only mode and applies strict=false. No external .pt file is admitted.
Source order changes source-specific encoders and learned scales; node-union ordering changes indexed parameters. Both are part of the artifact identity.
The primary paper reports BIONIC v0.2.4 while this census pins the later v0.2.6 source. Results must name the selected software version rather than imply exact paper-code reproduction.

The cross-modality projection places locus, variant, gene, peak, and other typed IDs into networks designed for genes/proteins. Namespacing prevents collision but does not restore typed biological semantics.
remaining_blockers: Promote the corrected 50-study COLOC release, then freeze one immutable evidence ontology, graph snapshot, native-build block map, source-provenance family map, candidate universe, and unsupported-versus-untestable states.
Resolve rights and exact graph joins for every admitted source; a transductive embedding can encode source topology and is not automatically redistributable merely because BIONIC is MIT licensed.

Create and hash one training-only undirected edge list per retained evidence source after held-source and held-block removal; freeze binary weighting, duplicate policy, source order, typed node map, masks, and common-support denominator.

Build an isolated legacy runtime only through SLURM and pass CPU plus optional L40S import, forward/backward, seed, sampler, memory, save, same-process inference, restart-trust-boundary, and numeric-tolerance probes.

Implement bounded edge/config/TSV validation, prohibit wildcard paths and pretrained_model_path, and pass fixtures proving that held-source and held-block edges and derivatives never reach preprocessing or sampling.
Create five per-split project artifacts and freeze graph, environment, config, model, feature, node-roster, raw-score, calibration, resource, and terminal-disposition hashes.
Identify and prospectively register a wholly sealed evidence source before selection lock. Without one, report development source-recovery results only and make no champion claim.
